rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable and appropriately cautious about single-image limits, but it overstates confidence in AA features; the image does not clearly show a tightly packed ICM or uniformly cohesive TE, and comments about no collapse/hole formation are not strongly supported.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, sperm quality, BMI, diagnosis, endometrium, and alcohol use into prognosis well, though some links to embryo competence are somewhat broad.

Overall logical and internally consistent, with a clear chain from morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include speculative comparison of 3AA vs image and some overinterpretation of alcohol/endometrial thickness effects.

Largely consistent with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF counseling that morphology is imperfect and age matters; minor deviations include somewhat speculative statements about lining thickness and alcohol impact on implantation probability.

Provides some practical guidance such as proceeding with transfer and advising alcohol abstinence, but future cycle planning and transfer-specific next steps are only partially developed and not highly detailed.
